header.title: Transfer between applications
header.subtitle: Copy a timeline from one editing application to another, frame accurate.

form.richAeHint: Transforms, speed and precomps, instead of a plain copy of the shots. Media and encoding are then set in the panel below.
form.upscaleForcesReencode: Upscaling replaces pixels: Re-encode applies whatever is picked above.

preview.animationUnavailable: Keyframes unreadable: the source application refused the export that carries them. The transfer will place fixed values.
preview.mediaLess: {{count}} item(s) without media (matte, adjustment layer): no application can receive them.
preview.graphics: {{count}} title(s): rebuilt on the target from their text and style.
preview.graphicsUnsupported: {{count}} title(s): the target cannot rebuild them, they will not be transferred.

result.animatedNone: No keyframe read: DaVinci Resolve exposes none through scripting, only its XML export carries them.
result.containerFallback: {{count}} file(s) written as MOV: MP4 carries neither ProRes, DNxHR nor PCM.
result.tracksClamped: Tracks clamped: the target application could not create enough of them.
result.mediaLess: {{count}} item(s) without media (matte, adjustment layer): no application can receive them.
result.titlesRetimed: {{count}} title(s) kept the template duration: DaVinci Resolve offers no way to set it.
result.vehicleImport: Edit read by DaVinci Resolve: keyframes, audio levels and speed applied by the application itself.
result.vehicleApi: Clips placed one by one by script: keyframes come from what NetsuRush read.
result.exchangeFile: DaVinci Resolve refused the edit via scripting. The same file imports correctly by hand — keyframes and audio levels included: File ▸ Import ▸ Timeline.

copy.label: Direct links
copy.hint: Original files linked as they are. No file written.

remux.label: Rewrap
remux.hint: New container, lossless. Useful when the target cannot read the source one.

reencode.label: Re-encode
reencode.hint: Every shot transcoded to an editing codec, cut frame accurate.
